nodes.name: Power BI Alt Text UDF Library
nodes.summary: Juls-BI open-source library of DAX User-Defined Functions that generate WCAG-compliant screen-reader alt text for Power BI visuals (progress bars, bullet charts, spark bars, rating dots, status pills, variance chips).

nodes.name: DAX User-Defined Functions (UDFs)
nodes.summary: DAX UDFs use DEFINE FUNCTION ... RETURN syntax in DAX Query View or TMDL, replacing hardcoded SWITCH/IF patterns scattered across measures with single parameterized reusable functions.

nodes.name: BulletChartAltText UDF
nodes.summary: DAX UDF generating screen-reader-friendly alt text for a bullet/target chart visual in Power BI. Takes visual context, actual value, target value, and optional range values, returning a plain-language narrative (e.g., Sales of $48,000 achieved 96% of the $50,000 target). WCAG-compliant and visual-agnostic.

nodes.name: Calculation Items Apply Only to Measure References
nodes.summary: A calculation item is applied only when it encounters a measure reference in the evaluation chain. CALCULATE containing only a constant with no measure reference will silently skip the calculation item. Any expression that is not a direct measure reference may have its own independent measure reference.

nodes.name: DAX Query View
nodes.summary: Power BI Desktop preview feature introduced November 2023, providing a query editor with toolbar (Run, Format, Comment, Uncomment, Search & Replace), a Data Pane for browsing tables/columns/measures with right-click Quick Queries, a Results pane for output, and Query Pages (tabbed, saved inside the PBIX). Must be explicitly enabled in Options and requires a restart.

nodes.name: dwp.ABCBand UDF
nodes.summary: Parameterized DAX UDF that converts a cumulative percentage to ABC classification tiers. Replaces hardcoded SWITCH statements with a single function accepting CumulativePercent (NUMERIC) and overridable TierA/TierB threshold defaults (0.8 and 0.95). Named parameter syntax preserves backward compatibility when deploying across models.

nodes.name: dwp.CurrencyAwareGrowth UDF
nodes.summary: DAX UDF demonstrating correct use of AnyRef (expression) parameter type for context-correct growth percentage calculation. The key lesson: AnyRef allows CALCULATE inside the UDF to control evaluation context; NUMERIC evaluates the measure too early and silently returns wrong values with no error.

nodes.name: dwp.SafeDivide UDF
nodes.summary: DAX UDF replacing all ad-hoc IF(Denominator=0, BLANK(), DIVIDE(...)) patterns across a model with a single typed function. Both parameters are NUMERIC (value type), evaluating eagerly. Consolidates 6 near-identical copy-pasted measures into one reusable function returning BLANK on zero denominator.

nodes.name: AnyRef Expression Parameter Enables CALCULATE Context Control
nodes.summary: When a DAX UDF parameter is declared as AnyRef (expression type), the measure expression is passed unevaluated. Wrapping it in CALCULATE inside the UDF then fires context transition correctly. If the same parameter is declared as NUMERIC, the measure is evaluated before CALCULATE can act on it and the context transition never fires.

nodes.name: Define and Evaluate
nodes.summary: DAX Query View action triggered by right-clicking any measure in the Data Pane and selecting Define and Evaluate. Shows the measure's full DAX formula and its output value in the current filter context in one click, replacing the need to add a measure to a visual or write an EVALUATE statement.

nodes.name: Define with References and Evaluate
nodes.summary: DAX Query View advanced action showing the full dependency chain of a measure, recursively including all referenced measures with their formulas and current values. Essential for auditing measure hierarchies, tracing unexpected results, and documenting what a complex measure depends on before deletion.

nodes.name: Context Transition in DAX
nodes.summary: DAX mechanism where row context is converted to equivalent filter context when a measure reference is evaluated inside CALCULATE. Critical for correct evaluation of measures in iterator contexts. Does not fire when the measure expression is passed as NUMERIC (value) parameter instead of AnyRef (expression).

nodes.name: NUMERIC Parameter Type Evaluates Eagerly
nodes.summary: When a DAX UDF parameter is declared as NUMERIC (value type), it is evaluated immediately at the call site using the caller's filter context. This makes it suitable for simple arithmetic values but unsuitable for measures requiring context control inside the UDF body.

nodes.name: Juls-BI
nodes.summary: Power BI content creator and open-source contributor who maintains the Power BI Alt Text UDF Library on GitHub (github.com/Juls-BI/powerbi-alttext-udfs), providing WCAG-compliant UDFs for accessibility in Power BI reports.

nodes.name: dwp Author
nodes.summary: Author of the DAX UDF library discussed in the GA UDF migration article, who migrated 59 copy-pasted measures into a single reusable library using DEFINE FUNCTION syntax, demonstrating parameterized functions, named parameters, and expression vs value parameter types.

nodes.name: ABC Classification (Pareto Banding)
nodes.summary: Inventory and Pareto analysis technique that classifies items into A (top ~80% of cumulative value), B (~80-95%), and C (remainder) tiers based on cumulative percentage of total. Implemented in DAX as parameterized UDFs replacing hardcoded SWITCH statements.

nodes.name: Safe Division Pattern
nodes.summary: DAX anti-pattern and solution pattern: wrapping DIVIDE in IF(Denominator=0, BLANK(), ...) or using DIVIDE directly which natively returns BLANK on zero denominator. The dwp.SafeDivide UDF standardizes this across all measures in a model.

nodes.name: DAX Query View UI Components
nodes.summary: The four main components of DAX Query View: Query Editor (center, with toolbar), Data Pane (right, browse model with right-click Quick Queries), Results (bottom, tabular output), and Query Pages (bottom tab strip, queries persist inside PBIX).

nodes.name: DAX Measures Can Have Deep Dependency Chains
nodes.summary: Well-structured measure models use measure branching: base measures aggregate data, mid-level measures compute KPIs, top-level measures calculate ratios or variances. The Define with References and Evaluate action in DAX Query View reveals the entire recursive dependency tree for any measure in the chain.

edges.description: BulletChartAltText is one of six visual pattern UDFs in the Power BI Alt Text UDF Library.
dwp.ABCBand exemplifies the parameterized DAX UDF pattern, replacing hardcoded SWITCH logic with a single function.
dwp.SafeDivide exemplifies the parameterized DAX UDF pattern, consolidating 6 ad-hoc zero-denominator IF patterns into one typed function.
dwp.CurrencyAwareGrowth exemplifies the DAX UDF pattern and serves as the key worked example for AnyRef expression parameter behavior.
dwp.CurrencyAwareGrowth is the primary worked example demonstrating why AnyRef expression parameters are needed for context-correct measure evaluation.
dwp.ABCBand uses NUMERIC value parameters for its three numeric inputs, all of which evaluate eagerly without needing context control.
dwp.SafeDivide uses NUMERIC value parameters for Numerator and Denominator, both pure arithmetic with no measure dependency.
dwp.CurrencyAwareGrowth requires AnyRef for its MeasureExpr parameter so CALCULATE inside the UDF body can control context correctly.

If MeasureExpr in dwp.CurrencyAwareGrowth were declared as NUMERIC instead of AnyRef, CALCULATE would evaluate the measure too early and the context transition would never fire, returning incorrect values silently.
Both calculation items and CALCULATE-based UDFs depend on measure references to trigger their context-manipulation logic; without a measure reference, neither fires.
Define and Evaluate is a specific right-click action within the Data Pane of DAX Query View.
Define with References and Evaluate is an advanced right-click action within the Data Pane of DAX Query View that shows the full dependency tree.
Define with References and Evaluate reveals the measure-dependency chain by recursively showing all referenced measures with their formulas and values.
The November 2023 preview feature introduction describes the DAX Query View as a feature that must be explicitly enabled in Options.
The four UI components (Query Editor, Data Pane, Results, Query Pages) describe the DAX Query View layout and capabilities.
Juls-BI authored the Power BI Alt Text UDF Library, available on GitHub at github.com/Juls-BI/powerbi-alttext-udfs.
The dwp author wrote the article documenting the migration of 59 copy-pasted measures to a GA DAX UDF library.
ABC classification (Pareto analysis) is the business domain implemented by the dwp.ABCBand UDF.
dwp.SafeDivide formalizes the safe division pattern, consolidating 6 near-identical copy-pasted measures into one reusable function.
